description: Looks up Tailwind's own default colors, exactly as Tailwind defines them: a whole color (e.g. "blue", all shades) or one shade (e.g. "slate-500"), for Tailwind v4, v3, v2 or v1. Use it instead of writing default Tailwind color values from memory. Values are oklch() in v4 and hex in older versions.

name.description: A default Tailwind color, like "blue", or one shade of it, like "blue-500"

tailwindVersion.description: The project's Tailwind CSS major version. Defaults to 4

name: get_tailwind_palette

shades.description: All shades, or only the one asked for

className.description: Color part of a utility class, e.g. "blue-500" for bg-blue-500

value.description: Tailwind's value: oklch() in v4, hex in older versions

title: Get Tailwind's default colors
